title: 有馬記念の後に・逃げて逃げて逃げた

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky seizes victory at the Arima Kinen and receives generous praise from her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd doesn't skip out on the adoration either. But instead of calling her a trickster, they're claiming that, beyond a shadow of a doubt, she's a first-rate Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's clear now that Seiun Sky has managed to reel in the biggest catch there is. Now, all that's left is to continue her racing career under the spotlight of popularity.
